en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard. The front shows the hall or lounge of a hotel with armchairs and tables, large windows with lace curtains, potted plants and a wall‑sized pastoral mural depicting trees, water and swans. The reverse side has printed Hungarian text identifying the location, publisher information from Budapest, a price in forints, and handwritten Hungarian correspondence and address, along with a partially visible postmark and stamp area.
